scientific_limitations: Only ordered pairs of two-sided ideals in kQ/J^2 over finite fields; not higher products, nonreduced ideal schemes or isomorphism classes. General framework for ideal semigroups is pre-existing; priority of the explicit transfer formula is provisional.
title: A three-state census of ordered annihilating ideal pairs in radical-square-zero quiver algebras
